AuthorValue: Outside users hit build and correctness problems. The first post-gap commits are 'Make it compile in Ubuntu.' (May 2025), 'Increase maxium heap size for testsuite (#692)', and fixes for wrong time calculations in the financial-chart examples, followed by CI-warning cleanups.

CRAN/infrastructure maintenance. On 2025-05-14 the author added nix support and GitHub Actions, deployed gh-pages docs, and committed 'trying to pass CRAN checks', a one-day burst to keep the package building and listed.

A new Apollo version. Recovery starts with 'Merge pull request #56 from daohu527/r7.0.0' (May 2024) and 'feat(planning): add planning scenarios', followed by a 'release a new statement' doc update and an external image-path fix (PR #59).

AuthorValue: Third-party adaptation. The post-gap commits (Apr 2022) are by Paciente8159 adding µCNC firmware support (updated alarm/error/setting codes, ESTOP, probe X/Y offset), including 'Merge pull request #1 from Paciente8159/ucnc-mods'. That is fork activity that WoC links to this project, not upstream development. Upstream only received sporadic PRs later (deHarro README 2024, typo fixes Apr 2025).
KeyEvidence: Commits describing the integration of uCNC systems

AuthorValue: Staff returned to work. Post-gap commits resume normal work immediately: bug fixes ('Fixed bug in the labels of hidtmgen. Fixes #797', qview band-bin fix) and merging a pending Cassini-Rings branch into trunk (Ref #775).
Resumed normal release cadence: v2.33.17 (Apr 7, 2025), then v2.34.0–v2.34.3 within April, and v2.35.0/v2.36.0 by June.

Project repurposed as a public open-source lab tool. After 'Latest version used for kaaki's master's thesis' (Sep 2019) and a README edited on Bitbucket (repo migration), PI Rod Van Meter added Authors.txt, a project definition, References.md and an FAQ (Jan 2020), and Chibikuri added Docker build instructions.
ValidatorValue: Began use for research or academic purposes
AdjudicatedValue: Finished master's thesis project repurposed by the PI into the lab's public open-source research tool
KeyEvidence: Commit regarding use of project for a thesis
